messages:
maria_cs: dropping notes from today's renewal prep calls. customers asked for a 'renewal one-pager' they can hand to finance: include usage trend, incidents summary, enablement completion, and a short list of open product asks.
kevin_onboarding: add onboarding checklist status too so CSMs can show progress during renewal meetings.
anya_support: finance also wants per-team (API key) token attribution for chargebacks. we get this ask a lot.
sam_product: proposed scope: Phase 1 = CSV export joining usage, incidents, enablement flags; Phase 2 = console download + per-api-key rollups.
eva_data: Phase 1 estimate: 2 sprints to build a scheduled aggregate and CSV endpoint. Phase 2 requires request-lineage work, ~4 sprints.
jamie_pm: quick UX wins: show 'last index / embedding update' timestamp in index panel (2 dev days); add onboarding checkbox to auto-seed demo embeddings (1 sprint).
triage-bot: reminder: create JIRA epic CS-ONEPAGER-4012 'Renewal one-pager export'.
maria_cs: actions: eva to post data spec, sam to draft product brief with sample columns, kevin to pull 3 customer quotes, anya to paste support threads. I'll send customers an interim note that export MVP is prioritized. :thumbsup:
